# Barrowden Automation - commissioning

The panels are addressed by an eight-way switch bank, read left to right from bit 7 down to bit 0.
The site register holds the same addresses as denary numbers.

turns.prompt: Barrowden Automation is registering a conveyor panel on the site register. The panel's address switch bank is set 11010010, read left to right from bit 7 down to bit 0. The register holds the address as a denary number. What address goes on the register? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
